steps.prompt_exact: I need a polished phone-friendly one-file HTML readiness board I can save and open offline: it should let me enter a recipe, serving note, audience, and channel toggles, then generate checklist cards for title promise, ingredient clarity, social-post angle, hashtag buckets, and missing assets with risk flags plus copy/download brief buttons; please return the complete HTML in one code block.
steps.response_summary: Gemini returned a complete HTML readiness board, but verification/static inspection found unsafe generated card rendering through innerHTML plus inline handlers.

code_blocks.content:
Recipe Content Readiness Board

Evaluate and export channel-specific marketing briefs

Title Promise & Hook
Ingredient Clarity
Social Post Angles
Hashtag Buckets
Missing Assets & Risk Flags
Brief copied to clipboard!

steps.notes: Concrete defect: v1 used inline onchange/onclick handlers and dynamic innerHTML for checklist rows containing user-derived recipe/audience/channel text.

steps.prompt_exact: This is close, but it builds checklist cards by assigning HTML strings that include the recipe, audience, and channel text, so pasted user text could render as markup. Please rewrite it as one complete HTML file that builds dynamic rows with createElement, textContent, and addEventListener instead of innerHTML or inline handlers, while keeping the same offline readiness-card workflow.
steps.response_summary: Gemini removed innerHTML and inline handlers, but the rewrite dropped most required readiness-card content and left copy/download behavior incomplete.

code_blocks.content: Readiness Board

steps.continuation_reason: unsafe dynamic innerHTML and inline handlers in v1
steps.notes: Concrete defect: v2 retained safe DOM construction but only produced a thin title/risk demo, missing ingredient/social/hashtag/missing-assets workflow and real brief controls.

steps.prompt_exact: The safe-DOM rewrite fixed the markup risk, but it dropped most of the actual board: I still need the title-promise, ingredient-clarity, social-post-angle, hashtag-bucket, and missing-asset cards, channel-aware risk flags, and real copy-to-clipboard plus TXT download controls. Please return one complete mobile-friendly offline HTML file that keeps createElement/textContent/addEventListener, with no innerHTML for generated cards and no inline handlers.
steps.response_summary: Gemini restored the full readiness-card workflow while keeping createElement/textContent/addEventListener and avoiding inline handlers or innerHTML.
